mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low and stable unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) combined with increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above its 5-year average signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real disposable income (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals decreased consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS is below its 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening with inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both increasing.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of non-recessionary instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but this effect is muted during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of non-tightening instances when GDPC1 > 3%.
